_comment: Motion vocabulary of the split-motion harness (from research/kallaway-20.md). The planner picks from it; scenes.py compiles it; memory/history.json records what each reel used so the next reel picks differently (novelty.py). Round 2: stillness is the default; continuous camera only on hero beats; soft settles; no sliding.

layouts.split: top motion panel + TALL speaker card (default 940 px of 1920, --speaker-h) + seam caption just above the card
layouts.speaker: full-screen 9:16 speaker, caption below the chin; Kallaway ~27 %, 1.5-4 s runs, every 4-8 s
layouts.graphic: full-screen graphic, no speaker (caption mid-screen); Kallaway rare (0-30 %, 2 of 20 reels)

orbit.use: a concept with many examples (formats, creators, ideas)
orbit.sfx: glow on land, ticks on items

doc.use: a script / template / plan with parts

list.use: numbered steps / top-N; unrevealed rows are ghost-blurred

phone.use: an app / a post / a platform / followers

compare.use: A vs B, wrong vs right, before/after
compare.sfx: whoosh between, ding on the winner

quote.use: a short punchline that is NOT the caption (validator turns caption-echo quotes into glass objects)

chapter.use: a new section (1-2-3 device); camera flies through the number

cta.use: the closing 'comment WORD to get X'

steps.use: a path / process / stairs to a goal

icon.fields: icon (see icons), label (optional, ONE key word not being said)
icon.use: one concrete object, rendered as a lit glass object (glow, rim light, drawn icon)

chat.use: a DM / dialogue / a question someone asks

hero3d.use: 1-3 per reel, the strongest object beats only (costly)

custom_svg.fields: svg (viewBox 0 0 900 800, <=40 elements, stroke-based line art, classes: d = draw, p = pop)
custom_svg.use: a NEW drawing for a concept the library lacks — the novelty slot

motion_rules.default: arrive (0.5-0.8 s eased settle, tiny overshoot: back.out(1.15) / expo.out) then HOLD
motion_rules.hero: 2-4 beats per reel (validator caps at ~1 per 6 beats): one slow push / pull / parallax / tilt over the beat
motion_rules.never: constant drift, slide-ins across the frame, whips, bounce, class snapping, counting small integers
motion_rules.substance: compiler adds per scene: soft accent glow, a particle burst that decelerates into stillness, a one-time light sweep (every 3rd scene + heroes)
motion_rules.budget: QC: ambient-motion share of in-beat hold frames <= 0.25 (jumps.py)
